package registry_test

import (
	"errors"
	"os"
	"testing"

	"example.com/companions/game/entities/archive"
	"example.com/companions/game/entities/journal"
	"example.com/companions/internal/registry"
	"github.com/tjbdwanghaibo/roost-core/framework/entity"
)

func TestGeneratedPair(t *testing.T) {
	if err := registry.RegisterAll(); err != nil {
		t.Fatal(err)
	}
	calls := 0
	mgr := entity.NewEntityManager(entity.WithEntityIDGenerator(func() (uint64, error) {
		calls++
		return 0, errors.New("unexpected new unique ID")
	}))
	access := entity.NewManagerAccess(mgr)
	p, err := access.Create(&entity.EntityCreateParam{IsCreate: true, Kind: archive.EntityKindArchive, UniqueID: 73})
	if err != nil {
		t.Fatal(err)
	}
	child, err := journal.CreateJournalForPrincipal(access, p.ID())
	if err != nil {
		t.Fatal(err)
	}
	if child.UniqueID() != 73 || child.ID() == p.ID() || child.GetEntityKind() != journal.EntityKindJournal {
		t.Fatalf("identity: %d, %d", p.ID(), child.ID())
	}
	id, err := entity.CompanionID(p.ID(), journal.EntityKindJournal)
	if err != nil || mgr.Get(id) != child {
		t.Fatalf("exact lookup by derived id: %d, %v", id, err)
	}
	remoteKind := os.Getenv("COMPANION_FIXTURE_REMOTE_KIND")
	if entity.IsEntityKindRemoteManaged(archive.EntityKindArchive) != (remoteKind == "Archive") || entity.IsEntityKindRemoteManaged(journal.EntityKindJournal) != (remoteKind == "Journal") {
		t.Fatalf("wrong fixture policies for remote kind %q", remoteKind)
	}
	snap := entity.SnapshotCompanionDomain(child)
	if remoteKind == "" {
		if snap.Root != p || len(snap.Members) != 2 {
			t.Fatalf("local child not attached: %+v", snap)
		}
	} else {
		if snap.Root != child || len(snap.Members) != 0 {
			t.Fatalf("remote participant attached without exclusive grant: %+v", snap)
		}
		if err := mgr.AttachCompanion(child.ID()); !errors.Is(err, entity.ErrCompanionScope) {
			t.Fatalf("direct attach for a registered Remote-managed kind must require a handler scope: %v", err)
		}
		if entity.SnapshotCompanionDomain(child).Root != child {
			t.Fatal("rejected attach changed the child's domain")
		}
	}
	if _, err := journal.CreateJournalForPrincipal(access, p.ID()); err == nil || mgr.Get(id) != child {
		t.Fatal("duplicate Create must fail without replacing the child")
	}
	if _, err := journal.CreateJournalForPrincipal(access, child.ID()); err == nil {
		t.Fatal("accepted child as principal")
	}
	if _, err := journal.CreateJournalForPrincipal(access, 0); err == nil {
		t.Fatal("accepted missing principal ID")
	}
	if calls != 0 {
		t.Fatalf("ID generator called %d times", calls)
	}
}
